findings.title: Stateless Referral Routing (Missing AI Referrer Context Bridge)
findings.evidence: No static DOM scripts or Edge header inspect rules detected for AI referrer domains (e.g., chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai).

suggested_action.summary: Deploy Edge Middleware / Frontend Context Bridge to inspect Referer headers and render personalized banners.
suggested_action.impact: Eliminates state loss when users click citations, preserving pre-conditioned intent upon site entry.

findings.title: Missing Heading ID Anchors for Deep AI URL Citation Linking
findings.evidence: Found 28 headings (<h1-h6>), but 0 have explicit 'id' attributes for URL hash deep-linking.

suggested_action.summary: Assign explicit, human-readable 'id' attributes to all major section headings.
suggested_action.impact: Allows AI assistants to construct exact hash citation links (e.g., page.html#specifications) preventing scroll state loss.

findings.title: Attribute Extraction Hallucination Hazard (Specs Hidden in Accordions/Images)
findings.evidence: Core technical specifications are missing above the fold and trapped inside 0 accordion containers or image files.

suggested_action.summary: Extract key technical attributes into static, uncollapsed DOM markup using Schema.org/PropertyValue.
suggested_action.impact: Prevents AI assistants from fabricating missing technical metrics during multi-brand comparisons.

proactive_recommendations: Deploy a root /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt markdown index to provide RAG systems with clean brand context.
Include high-authority sameAs links (e.g., Wikidata, Wikipedia, Crunchbase) inside Schema.org/Organization JSON-LD markup.
